The glow from each lamp pools softly on the surface below, and these illuminated patches hold their shape and brightness without fluctuation. In the lower-left corner, a Japanese smart-lighting control panel remains overlaid, headed by the group list label and showing two named groups, a living-room lighting row with a white color swatch and a table-light row with a red swatch. Each row keeps its ON/OFF toggle and color-switch buttons visible and unchanged. The camera framing stays fixed, with the track, ceiling line, and overlay holding constant positions relative to one another. No lighting state changes occur, leaving the scene in a steady all-on condition for the entire duration.
